_doc: WIM Brain configuration (wim_brain.py). Copy, rename, and edit. Paths are relative to experiments/embodied/.
_comment_name: Display name shown in game HUD and monitor.
name: my-wim-brain
_comment_brain_path: Save/load path (.npz). Loaded automatically on startup if file exists.
_comment_log_path: CSV training log. Empty string = no log.
_comment_world_config: Ruleset this brain was trained on. Used in headless mode.
_comment_grid_size: Grid dimensions: grid_size x grid_size = total nodes (N). 64 = 4096 nodes, 128 = 16384 nodes.
_comment_tension: Spring stiffness — controls wave propagation speed. Higher = faster waves.
_comment_reverb: Wave persistence [0, 1]. Higher = longer echoes. Maps to damping via cubic curve: damping = 0.15 * (1 - reverb)^3.
_comment_noise_scale: Per-step Gaussian noise on free nodes. 0 = deterministic waves. Low values (0.01) add richness.
_comment_input_scale: Amplitude scale for observation injection at input nodes.
_comment_anchor_layout: Anchor pattern when brain_layout=false. 'golden' (Vogel spiral) or 'centered' (3x3 grid).
_comment_brain_layout: Enable bilateral brain layout: corpus callosum barrier + cross-lateralized sensory input.
_comment_approach_bias: Forward W_out bias on visual input nodes. Creates a structural 'approach what you see' prior. 0 = no bias.
_comment_turn_bias: Contralateral turn prior on visual nodes. Strengthens structural tracking. 0 = rely on random W_out asymmetry.
_comment_normalize_dynamics: Scale damping and substeps with grid size so waves travel similar proportional distances at any resolution.
_comment_readout_vel: Read the full wave phasor [tanh(disp), tanh(vel)] instead of amplitude only. The medium holds z = disp + i*vel; dropping vel discards ~half the binding capacity (holographic experiment #2a). Old disp-only checkpoints are auto-migrated (vel weights start at 0).
_comment_explore_noise: Gaussian noise on fwd/turn outputs before tanh. Much lower than ESN (wave dynamics are gentler).
_comment_eat_threshold: Raw eat output above which eat fires. 0.0 = eat whenever output is positive.
_comment_learn_lr: Actor learning rate — scales RPE-weighted eligibility trace update to W_out.
_comment_critic_lr: Critic learning rate — how fast valence_pred tracks the running reward signal. Should be ~10x actor lr.
_comment_teacher_force_lr: Supervised readout nudge during teleoperation. The brain learns from the demonstrated action directly.
_comment_trace_decay: Eligibility trace decay per step. 0.99 = ~1.7s memory at 60 fps.
_comment_weight_decay: L2 regularisation on W_out per step. Prevents unbounded growth.
_comment_hebbian_plasticity: Enable per-edge spring tension learning (Hebbian plasticity). Teleop-gated: springs strengthen between co-active nodes during teleop demonstrations.
_comment_hebbian_lr: Learning rate for tension updates during teleop. Higher = faster pathway formation.
_comment_tension_min: Lower clamp for per-edge tension. Prevents dead springs (0 = disconnected).
_comment_tension_max: Upper clamp for per-edge tension. Prevents instability. Keep <= 3x base tension.
_comment_tension_decay: Rate of return toward baseline tension per step. Unreinforced pathways gradually fade.
_comment_hebb_trace_decay: EMA decay for co-displacement trace. Lower = shorter memory of recent wave patterns.
_comment_log_capacity: Rolling observation log size. 5000 = ~83s at 60 fps.
_comment_seed: Random seed for W_out initialisation and input node placement.
_comment_action_feedback: Feed previous (fwd, turn, eat) back into reservoir. Recommended when using Hebbian plasticity.
_comment_decision_interval: Hold each action for N frames. Higher = smoother, fewer decisions/sec.
